title: Delete or fix the dead, non-compiling tool/seed_content_db.dart fragment at repo root
rule: Tier-2 AREA NOTE: dead code, drift between duplicated configs
why: The file this batch was asked to audit — root-level tool/seed_content_db.dart (242 lines) — has NO imports, NO `void main()`, and references types/constants (Dio, ContentDatabase, _Args, _curricula, _maxConcurrentFetches, ...) that are defined nowhere in the file. It cannot compile as a standalone Dart script. The real, complete, actively-referenced seed-build tool lives at learning_tracker/tool/seed_content_db.dart (809 lines, proper imports, invoked by learning_tracker/Makefile:236,239 and documented everywhere as `cd learning_tracker && ...`). The root copy is tracked in git, has its own commit history, and is not referenced by any Makefile target or doc's actual invocation instructions — it is pure orphaned duplicate content that will confuse anyone (human or agent) who opens 'tool/seed_content_db.dart' from repo root expecting the real build tool.
recommendation: Delete the root-level tool/seed_content_db.dart (git history preserves it) since the canonical tool already lives at learning_tracker/tool/seed_content_db.dart. If some workflow genuinely needs a repo-root entry point, make it a one-line wrapper that shells into the real file, not a stale content fork.
acceptance_criteria: tool/seed_content_db.dart at repo root is removed (or reduced to a documented redirect), and `dart run tool/seed_content_db.dart` from repo root either doesn't exist as a workflow or correctly delegates to learning_tracker/tool/seed_content_db.dart.
A grep/CI check fails if two files share a basename under tool/** and learning_tracker/tool/** with diverging content, to prevent recurrence.
